title: Auditing Future-Memory Use in Point-in-Time Language Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.18602v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Point-in-time (PIT) agents can recall post-cutoff facts even when their external evidence respects a historical cutoff. We examine whether this access predicts evidence gathering in 48 historical company-comparison tasks. Independent closed-book revenue probes identify the better-remembered company for each model on tasks with unequal recall, fixing the predicted direction before agent runs. We then compare paired runs with real or anonymized company identities while keeping external evidence PIT-valid. Both Qwen and DeepSeek recalled future facts, but neither supported the prespecified shift toward the better-remembered company. Qwen's four allocation estimates on 28 unequal-recall tasks were negative, with descriptive intervals spanning zero. translated_title: 审计时点语言智能体中的未来记忆使用
translated_abstract: 时点（PIT）智能体即使在外部证据遵守历史截止日期的情况下，仍能回忆起截止日期之后的事实。我们在48个历史公司比较任务中检验了这种能力是否能预测证据收集行为。通过独立的闭卷收入探测，我们在回忆不平等的任务上为每个模型识别出记忆程度更好的公司，并在智能体运行之前预先固定预测方向。随后，我们在保持外部证据符合时点有效性的前提下，比较了使用真实或匿名化公司身份的配对运行结果。Qwen和DeepSeek均能回忆起未来事实，但两者均不支持预先设定的向记忆更好公司的偏移。Qwen在28个回忆不平等任务上的四项分配估计值均为负，其描述性区间跨越零。一项前瞻性的DeepSeek复现实验在20个此类任务的所有四项指标上显示出相反的模式，区间低于零。在对每家公司、公司对及未来记忆因素进行调整后，这些估计值仍保持为负。
tldr: 本研究审计发现，尽管Qwen和DeepSeek等时点语言智能体能够回忆起训练截止日期后的“未来事实”，但这种未来记忆并不能预测或影响其在使用符合历史截止要求的外部证据时的任务分配与证据收集行为。
en_tdlr: This study audits whether point-in-time language agents' recall of post-cutoff "future facts" predicts their evidence-gathering behavior, finding that although Qwen and DeepSeek both recalled future facts, this memory did not bias task allocation in historical company-comparison tasks with PIT-valid external evidence.
